title: Lower Bounds on Essential Dimension for Congruence Covers of Mixed Shimura Varieties
summary: We use the fixed point method and toroidal compactifications to establish general lower bounds for the essential dimension of congruence covers $Γ' \backslash \mathcal{X}^0 \rightarrow Γ\backslash \mathcal{X}^0$ of mixed Shimura varieties. Our main result shows that $\mathrm{ed}_{\mathbb{C}}(Γ' \backslash \mathcal{X}^0 \rightarrow Γ\backslash \mathcal{X}^0; p)$ is bounded from below by the dimension of certain unipotent subgroups associated with the rational boundary components of the given mixed Shimura datum.
